title: [Performance][Model] Fuse MiniMax-M3 A3 index TopK helpers
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR ports the MiniMax-M3 A3 decode small-op fusion from the validated handoff runtime into current `main`.

The A3 AscendC index path previously ran `MsaIndexScore`, then several eager tensor operations around `torch.topk`, and finally `SparseAttentionScore`. This change keeps the two AscendC operators and `torch.topk`, while replacing the surrounding eager operations with two Triton helpers:

- fuse score masking, padding handling, and forced init/local block preparation before TopK;
- fuse TopK index conversion, invalid-index masking, and `select_num_idx` counting after TopK;
- wire the fused result only into the non-sharded A3 decode path;
- keep the legacy wrapper behavior by default, and leave TP-sharded decode, prefill, and A5 paths unchanged.

The implementation is an A3 adaptation based on the deployed handoff package. It is inspired by the A5 TopK optimization in Ascend-ShangHai-LLM/vllm-ascend#11, but is not a direct cherry-pick because A3 uses the AscendC `MsaIndexScore` output and needs different preparation/postprocessing.

This is complementary to #18204. With the no-TP-shard A3 selection in that PR, all A3 decode requests can use this non-sharded fused path.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. MiniMax-M3 A3 decode uses fewer small operator launches between `MsaIndexScore` and sparse attention. There is no API or configuration change.

### How was this patch tested?

- Added unit coverage for the fused helper source, A3 model-path wiring, wrapper dispatch, and fused count propagation.
- `ruff check` passed for all four changed files.
- `ruff format --check` passed for all four changed files.
- `python -m py_compile` passed for all four changed files.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- The handoff runtime profiling captured both Triton helper kernels executing on all 16 ranks. This confirms path activation in the source environment, but is not a fresh performance benchmark against current `main`.

Limitations:

- Targeted pytest execution was not available in the production container because its Python environment does not include `pytest`; the container and active NPU service were left unchanged.
- Full pre-commit bootstrap was blocked by an HTTP 504 from the configured internal Python package mirror while installing the hook environment.
- No current-main NPU benchmark was run because the accessible A3 container is serving an active workload.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607
